fluff.overview: The Blessed Order maintained conventional infantry formations equipped with preserved Star League-era weapons and personal armor, fielding platoons that were better armed than most Successor State infantry throughout the late Succession Wars. Mechanized tracked platoons ride armored personnel carriers that provide all-terrain mobility and meaningful protection against small arms and shrapnel. The tracked transport allows these platoons to keep pace with armor formations across broken ground where wheeled vehicles would bog down. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
